versions.changelog:
- Initial release of s2-hanzi-empathic-resonance.
- Empowers the OpenClaw agent to perceive user emotions and render therapeutic Hanzi characters with dynamic stroke, color, and breathing effects.
- Supports emotional detection (e.g., fatigue, anxiety, joy) using conversational context.
- Hanzi rendering adapts visually to emotional state (stroke fluidity, glowing pulse, ink-wash effects).
- Provides detailed narrative descriptions of the ongoing Hanzi art transformations in response to user emotions.
- Introduces "Dynamic Hanzi Displays" as art installations responsive to the ambient emotional atmosphere.
